theme: Lý do nghỉ việc & chuyển việc

vocab.example: After the restructure, my role became much narrower than before.
vocab.example_vi: Sau đợt tái cơ cấu, vai trò của tôi trở nên hẹp hơn nhiều so với trước.

vocab.meaning_vi: thử thách mới trong công việc
vocab.example: I am looking for a new challenge where I can lead bigger projects.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi đang tìm một thử thách mới nơi tôi có thể dẫn dắt các dự án lớn hơn.

vocab.meaning_vi: giai đoạn chuyển tiếp giữa hai công việc
vocab.example: I want a smooth transition, so I planned my handover very carefully.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi muốn quá trình chuyển tiếp suôn sẻ, nên tôi đã lên kế hoạch bàn giao rất kỹ.

vocab.example: My long-term plan is to stay in this field and become a team leader.
vocab.example_vi: Kế hoạch dài hạn của tôi là ở lại lĩnh vực này và trở thành trưởng nhóm.

vocab.meaning_vi: sự ổn định trong công việc
vocab.example: I value stability, but I also need room to grow every year.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi coi trọng sự ổn định, nhưng tôi cũng cần không gian để phát triển mỗi năm.

vocab.example: I would like to broaden my skills instead of doing the same reports.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi muốn mở rộng kỹ năng của mình thay vì làm mãi những báo cáo giống nhau.

vocab.example: In my next job I hope to take on more responsibility for the whole product.
vocab.example_vi: Ở công việc tiếp theo, tôi hy vọng nhận thêm trách nhiệm cho cả sản phẩm.

vocab.meaning_vi: sự thoả thuận của cả hai bên
vocab.example: We ended my contract by mutual agreement, and I finished my handover.
vocab.example_vi: Chúng tôi kết thúc hợp đồng theo thoả thuận hai bên, và tôi đã hoàn tất bàn giao.

listening.title: Interview: why are you leaving your current job?

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Nam, I see you are leaving your current company. May I ask why?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Of course. My team was restructured last quarter, and my role became very narrow.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: So the restructure changed your daily work?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes. I used to lead a small team, but now I only write reports.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: I understand. What are you looking for in your next job?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I am looking for a new challenge where I can take on bigger projects.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Do you want to stay in this field for the long-term?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Definitely. I want to broaden my skills, not change my career completely.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: How did your manager react when you told him about your decision?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: We talked openly and left by mutual agreement. My last day is next Friday.

lines.speaker: Hoa (HR Manager)
lines.text: Good. And what matters more to you, stability or fast growth?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Both, honestly. But a smooth transition and a clear plan matter most to me.

questions.q: Why is Nam leaving his current company?
options: His team was restructured and his role became narrow
He wants to move to another city
He had a serious conflict with his manager

questions.q: What does Nam want in his next job?
options: Fewer working hours and more holidays
A new challenge with bigger projects

questions.q: How did Nam leave his current company?
options: He was asked to leave immediately
By mutual agreement with his manager
He left without giving any notice
